normalized_text: welcome to another video probably the final video and the proofs of prophethood series when the prophet peace be upon him moved to medina he was surrounded by enemies hypocrites from within the house and tribes as well as the jews of medina after being navy a jewish tribe betrayed their alliance with the muslims there was a conversation that occurred between them and the hypocrites of medina have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy saying to their brothers who have disbelieved among the people of the scripture if you are expelled we will surely leave with you and we will not obey in regard to you anyone ever and if you are fought we will surely aid you but allah testifies that they are liars now keep in mind that this is a conversation occurring between benin and the hypocrites from this is not supposed to be a conversation that is occurring publicly it's a secret conversation that occurred in las pountana is exposing them for this a prophecy occurs in the very next verse if they are expelled they will not leave with them and if they are fought they will not aid them and even if they should aid them they will surely turn their backs then thereafter they will not be aided and that is exactly what occurred when beni navid were expelled the disbelievers did not leave with them despite the fact that the prophet peace be upon him recited these verses aloud publicly by doing this he was exposing the hypocrites and challenging them to fulfill their words and that my friends is a proof of prophethood assalamu alaikum
